title: Neon Turtle Plasma Globe
description: A glowing turtle with a neon green shell and purple limbs floats in the air, connected by blue electrical arcs to a large plasma globe. A human hand touches the glass sphere which emits vibrant pink, yellow, and blue plasma tendrils against a dark background.
prompt: A glowing turtle with a bright neon green hexagonal shell and purple furry limbs floats beside a large plasma globe on a wooden surface. The turtle is connected by bright blue electrical arcs to the sphere. A human hand touches the glass orb which contains a bright central core emitting vibrant pink, yellow, and blue plasma tendrils and sparks. Dramatic light rays shine from above, dark background, surreal and vibrant atmosphere.
